spans.s: वृश् vt. 4P (pres. वृश्यति) To choose, to select.

वृष् (I) vt. or vi. 1P (pp. वृष्ट; pres. वर्षति) 1. To rain, (either used impersonally or with such words as इंद्र, मेघ, पर्जन्य, देव as the subject), मेघा वर्षंतु गर्जंतु मूंचंत्वशनिमेव वा Mrich.v., or उन्नमति नमति वर्षंति गर्जंति मेघः करोति तिमिरौघम् ibid, or गर्ज वा वर्ष वा शक्र मुंच वा शतशोऽशनिम् ibid; 2. to shower down, to pour down, e.g. पुष्पवृष्टिमवर्षन्; 3. to give, to bestow; 4. to be capable of generating; 5. to have supreme power.With अभि-, 1. to shower, to rain; 2. to give, to bestow.With प्र-, to rain, to shower, प्रवर्षंति प्रेयसि चंद्रिकाभिश्चकोरचंचूचुलुकां प्रतीन्दुः Na.xxii.41.
वृष् (II) vi. 10Ā (pres. वर्षयते) 1. To be powerful; 2. to have the power of generation.
वृश (I) m. A rat.
वृश (II) n. Ginger.

वृष (I) m. 1. A bull, कैलासगौरं वृषमारुरुक्षोः R.ii.35, K.S.v.80, Megh.i.52; 2. the sign Taurus of the zodiac; 3. an epithet of the god of love; 4. a man of one of the four classes (in erotic works); 5. a rat; 6. an enemy, an adversary; 7. justice, morality; 8. merit, virtue; 9. a strong man; 10. (generally at the end of a compound) anything the best of its kind; 11. an epithet of Karṇa; 12. of Viṣṇu.
वृष (II) n. A peacock’s tail.
वृश्चिक m. 1. A scorpion; 2. the sign Scorpio of the zodiac; 3. a crab; 4. a centipede; 5. a kind of beetle; 6. a black bee.
वृष-अंक m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. the marking-nut plant; 3. a eunuch; 4. a pious man.
वृष-अंक˚ज m. a small drum.
वृष-अंचन m. an epithet of Śiva.
वृष-आहार m. a cat.
वृष-उत्सर्ग m. setting a bull liberty on the occasion of a funeral rite.
वृष-दंश, -दंशक m. a cat.
वृष-दंश, -दंशक m. a cat.
वृष-ध्वज m. 1. an epithet of Śiva, R.xi.44, Kir.xiii.28; 2. an epithet of Gaṇeśa; 3. a pious man.
वृष-पति m. an epithet of Śiva.
वृष-पर्वन् m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. name of a demon; (See App. II.); 3. a wasp.
वृष-भासा f. the residence of gods, i.e. Amarāvatī.
वृष-लोचन m. a rat.
वृष-वाहन m. an epithet of Śiva.
वृषण m. The scrotum, the bag which contains the testicles.
वृषन् m. 1. A bull; 2. the sign Taurus of the zodiac; 3. a horse; 4. pain, sorrow; 5. insensibility to pain; 6. an epithet of Karṇa; 7. of Indra, वृषेव सीतां तदवग्रहक्षताम् K.S.v.61, R.x.52, xvii.77.
वृषणश्व m. a horse of Indra.
वृषभ m. 1. A bull; 2. any male animal; 3. (at the end of a compound) anything the best of its kind; 4. an elephant’s ear; 5. the orifice of the ear.
वृषभ-गति, -ध्वज m. an epithet of Śiva, R.ii.36, K.S.iii.62.
वृषभ-गति, -ध्वज m. an epithet of Śiva, R.ii.36, K.S.iii.62.
वृषभी f. A widow.
वृषल (I) a. (f. ली) Irreligious.
वृषल (II) m. 1. A Śūdra; 2. a horse; 3. garlic; 4. a sinner; 5. an epithet of king Chandragupta, Mud.i., iii.
वृषल (I) a. (f. ली) Irreligious.

वृषली f. 1. An unmarried girl living at her father’s house in whom menstruation has commenced, (पितुर्गेहे च या नारी रजः पश्यत्यसंस्कृता । भ्रूणहत्या पितुस्तस्याः सा कन्या वृषली स्मृताः); 2. a barren woman; 3. a woman during menstruation; 4. a Śūdra woman; 5. the wife of a Śūdra.
वृषलक m. A contemptible Śūdra.
वृषली-पति m. the husband of a Śūdra woman.
वृषली-सेवन n. intercourse with a Śūdra female.
वृषसृक्की f. A wasp.
वृषस्यंती f. 1. A libidinous woman; 2. a cow in heat.
वृषाकपायी f. 1. An epithet of Lakṣmī; 2. of Gaurī; 3. of Śachī; 4. of Svāhā, the wife of Agni.
वृषाकपि m. 1. An epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. of Śiva; 3. of Indra; 4. of Agni.
वृषायण m. An epithet of Śiva.
वृषिन् m. A peacock.
वृषी(षि) f. The seat of a religious student made of kuśa grass.
वृषी(षि) f. The seat of a religious student made of kuśa grass.
वृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Rained; 2. showering, pouring down.
वृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Rained; 2. showering, pouring down.
वृष्टि f. 1. Rain, a shower of rain, Megh.i.20; 2. shower in general, (पुष्पवृष्टि R.ii.60, अस्रवृष्टि R.iii.58).
वृष्टि-काल m. the rainy season.
वृष्टि-जीवन a. watered by rain (as a country).
वृष्टि-भू m. a frog.
वृष्टि-मत् m. a plough.
वृष्णि (I) a. 1. Heretical; 2. angry, passionate.
वृष्णि (II) m. 1. Air, wind; 2. a cloud; 3. name of an ancestor of Kṛṣṇa; 4. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa; 5. of Indra; 6. a ray of light; 7. a rain.
वृष्णि-गर्भ m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
वृष्य (I) a. (f. ष्या) 1. To be showered down; 2. provocative of sexual vigour.
वृष्य (II) m. A kind of kidney-bean.
वृष्य (I) a. (f. ष्या) 1. To be showered down; 2. provocative of sexual vigour.
